name: Pro-Forming Sheet Metal LLC
old_description: We offer our Metal Custom Fabrication customers superior supplemental Metal Machining and Milling
about:
Pro-Forming Sheet Metal LLC operates from Norwich, Connecticut, where it has provided custom metal fabrication and machining services for more than 25 years. The shop began as a metal fabrication business and has since expanded its capabilities to include CNC punching, forming, welding, machining, and finishing.

The company offers a range of metal fabrication processes including CNC turret punching (30-ton, 25-station), CNC press brake forming (120-ton, 10-foot), roll forming, sawing, plasma and oxy-acetylene cutting, MIG and TIG welding, and basic machining such as milling, drilling, and turning. It also provides in-house wet painting, mechanical and turnkey assembly, prototyping, and machinery rebuilding. Pro-Forming handles short, medium, and long production runs, working with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, cast iron, and bronze.

Pro-Forming serves manufacturers in Connecticut and across the United States, producing parts such as precision brackets with tight tolerances and heavy-duty frames designed to support 30,000-pound machinery. Its customer base includes businesses needing custom metal fabrication, machining, and assembly services.

The company emphasizes a one-stop-shop approach, combining CAD design, CNC punching, forming, welding, machining, and finishing under one roof to control lead times and costs. It highlights its experienced craftsmen, with an average of over 20 years of industry experience, and its ability to hold tolerances to the thousandth of an inch.
